title: Pietro
wikitext:
In discussion about the best QW player ever often mentioned. Legendary for his time with [[Flaming Fist]] in particular, often being the quadrunner in the team that never lost an official game when he played. Also was a proffesional Magic: The Gathering player, see his [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jens_Thor%C3%A9n official wiki page] for more information. He later moved on to play Pokemon and he still plays Magic too.
